Hi Laura — thanks for the details.

Summary of what we can do and quick answers:
- Lead time: standard production + kitting for 1,400 total kits (incl. VIP) = 18 business days after artwork sign-off.
- Partial shipments: we can split into two shipments (we recommend 1,000 + 400) to ease venue receiving.
- QA: we do a 2% visual check during packing and provide a packing QC report. For on-site QC hold, we will clearly band pallet(s) and label VIP boxes; we can make a separate skid for VIP.
- VIP card reprints: current stock covers 150 VIP cards. Expedited reprint for additional 50 cards = $210 (overnight production + priority rush). Reprint turnaround: 48 hours from approval of proof.

Estimated costs (ballpark, final on formal quote):
- Per standard kit (materials + assembly): $2.40
- Per VIP kit incremental: $3.75
- Kitting/assembly fee (one-time): $650
- Shipping to NorthStage (LTL, palletized): ~$520 (two shipments)
- Expedited reprint (up to 50 cards): $210
- Total estimate: ~$3,800 (final will vary with exact quantities and packaging choices)

Attached: stitch_quote_0421.pdf with line items and an updated design proof (design_proof_v5.pdf). If you approve, we can issue a DocuSign quote for signature and begin production.

Let me know if you want us to proceed with initial proof sign-off — we can hold VIP card production until you confirm last counts.

Best,
